title: Albion Online crafting ranking by realizable silver per day
description: PlataRank sorts Albion Online recipes (alchemy, refining, cooking, gear and mounts) by profit × daily sales volume, not by per-unit margin. With a calculator, sessions and Discord alerts.

stationNotes.gear: Weapons, armor, bags, capes and gathering gear

capabilities: Ranking by silver per day: the margin is multiplied by the real sales volume.
Calculator with resource return, focus, station fee and taxes, plus links to share your calculation.
Crafting sessions to add up several items and load your real numbers.
Discord alerts when a saved recipe goes above the profit you set.

faq.whatIsA: PlataRank is a free Albion Online crafting ranking (Americas server). It sorts alchemy, refining, cooking, gear and mount recipes by the silver they earn per day, with prices that update every hour.
faq.silverPerDayA: It is the profit per unit multiplied by the daily sales volume and by the market share you assume. A recipe with a high margin that barely sells earns less than a low-margin one that sells all day.
faq.whatToCraftQ: What is worth crafting today in Albion Online?
faq.whatToCraftA: The one in the first row of the ranking with your assumptions (city, focus, market share). The block above shows the top five recipes right now, and each station has its own ranking.
faq.sourcesQ: Where do the prices and recipes come from?
faq.sourcesA: Prices come from the Albion Online Data Project, fed by players, and recipes from the client's official data dump. Outlier prices are filtered out and the detail of each formula is on the methodology page.
faq.officialA: No. It is a free community tool with no affiliation with Sandbox Interactive.
